meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
Choosing the right serum for acne-prone skin depends on your primary concern—whether you are dealing with **active pimples/clogged pores** or **post-acne dark spots and oil control**.

The best budget-friendly serums available in India under ₹700 are categorized below by skin need:

---

### 1. For Active Acne, Blackheads & Clogged Pores

* **Best Choice:** **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/acne-serum#:~:text=Add%20to%20Cart.%20Buy%20Foxtale%2012%25%20Niacinamide,ml.%20%E2%82%B9224%20%E2%82%B9249%2010%25%20off.%204.3%20%281786%29.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹549 for 30ml (Smaller 10ml bottles are also available under ₹250)[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/acne-serum#:~:text=10%20ml%2030%20ml%20%2B3%20Options%20%2B2.,Serum%20for%20Skin%20Brightening%20%26%20Anti-Dark%20Spots%7C.)
  * **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid (BHA) enhanced with Centella Water.[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/acne-serum#:~:text=Buy%20Garnier%20Vitamin%20C%20%2B%20Face%20Serum,%7C%2015%20ml-.%20Free%20Mini%20on%20349.)
  * **Why it works:** Salicylic acid is oil-soluble, meaning it deeply penetrates pores to dissolve trapped sebum, dead skin cells, and dirt that cause whiteheads, blackheads, and painful breakouts.[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=Its%20effectiveness%20comes%20from%202%25%20salicylic%20acid%2C,for%2030ml.%20Rating%3A%204.5%2F5%20on%20official%20website.)
  * *Alternative:* **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** (~₹499)[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=Its%20effectiveness%20comes%20from%202%25%20salicylic%20acid%2C,for%2030ml.%20Rating%3A%204.5%2F5%20on%20official%20website.)

### 2. For Active Acne + Post-Acne Marks (The Combo Approach)

* **Best Choice:** **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Serum[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=*%202.%20The%20Derma%20Co%20Sali-Cinamide%20Anti-Acne,for%20improvement%20in%20acne%20and%20acne%20marks.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹599 for 30ml[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=Apply%202-3%20drops%20twice%20daily%2C%20and%20it,botanical%20angle%20alongside%20standard%20salicylic%20acid%20treatment.)
  * **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid + 5% Niacinamide[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=Its%20effectiveness%20comes%20from%202%25%20salicylic%20acid,for%2030ml.%20Rating%3A%204.8%2F5%20on%20official%20website.)
  * **Why it works:** If you have pimples *and* stubborn dark marks left behind, this dual-action formula clears out pores with salicylic acid while niacinamide soothes inflammation and fades hyperpigmentation simultaneously.[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=Apply%20at%20night%202-3%20times%20a%20week,one%20step%20rather%20than%20two%20separate%20serums.)

### 3. For Excess Oil Control & Fading Acne Scars (No Exfoliating Acids)

* **Best Choice:** **Minimalist 10% Niacinamide Face Serum with 1% Zinc** or **Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Clarifying Serum[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-serum-for-oily-skin-in-india#:~:text=Price%20%7C%20%7C%20---%20%7C%20---%20%7C,Oily%2C%20acne-prone%20%7C%20%E2%82%B9600%20%2830%20ml%29%20%7C)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹599 (Minimalist) / ~₹452 - ₹645 (Foxtale)[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/acne-serum#:~:text=Add%20to%20Cart.%20Buy%20Foxtale%2012%25%20Niacinamide,ml.%20%E2%82%B9224%20%E2%82%B9249%2010%25%20off.%204.3%20%281786%29.)
  * **Key Ingredients:** Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) and Zinc PCA[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-serum-for-oily-skin-in-india#:~:text=Price%20%7C%20%7C%20---%20%7C%20---%20%7C,Oily%2C%20acne-prone%20%7C%20%E2%82%B9600%20%2830%20ml%29%20%7C)
  * **Why it works:** Ideal if your skin is prone to greasiness and post-acne dark spots, but you prefer to avoid harsh exfoliating acids. Zinc regulates sebum production, and niacinamide repairs the skin barrier while brightening uneven skin tone.[www.drsheths.com](https://www.drsheths.com/blogs/news/affordable-niacinamide-serums-under-800-for-daily-use#:~:text=This%20serum%20pairs%20niacinamide%20with%20powerful%20humectants,a%20moisturizing%20effect%20and%20a%20radiant%20finish.)

### 4. For Sensitive & Acne-Prone Skin (Calming Redness)

* **Best Choice:** **Dot & Key Cica + Niacinamide Face Serum[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-serum-for-oily-skin-in-india#:~:text=Serum%20for%20Oily%20Skin%20-%20Detailed%20Edition,Serum.%20*%2010.%20Pilgrim%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Serum.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹599 - ₹700 for 30ml[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-serum-for-oily-skin-in-india#:~:text=Price%20%7C%20%7C%20---%20%7C%20---%20%7C,Oily%2C%20acne-prone%20%7C%20%E2%82%B9600%20%2830%20ml%29%20%7C)
  * **Key Ingredients:** Cica (Centella Asiatica) and Niacinamide
  * **Why it works:** Cica is exceptionally soothing for inflamed, angry, or irritated acne-prone skin, helping reduce redness while keeping oil production balanced.

---

### Quick Buying Tips for Indian Weather:

* **Patch Test First:** Apply a drop on your inner elbow or jawline for 24 hours to check for any adverse reactions before applying it all over your face.
* **Sun Protection is Mandatory:** If you use a salicylic acid or clearing serum (especially during the day), always follow up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen to prevent acne marks from darkening further.

items.markdown: ### Quick Buying Tips for Indian Weather:
items.original_text: Quick Buying Tips for Indian Weather:

items.markdown:
* **Patch Test First:** Apply a drop on your inner elbow or jawline for 24 hours to check for any adverse reactions before applying it all over your face.
* **Sun Protection is Mandatory:** If you use a salicylic acid or clearing serum (especially during the day), always follow up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen to prevent acne marks from darkening further.
